title: Download JSON from a web address and keep only the fields you need
summary: Fetch a JSON answer from a web address with curl and let jq filter it, for example to keep only the names of active items. The result is a plain list of values, one per line.

aliases.text: get names from json api command line
extract values from json url terminal
скачать json и выбрать поля jq
достать данные из json по ссылке

steps.explain: Look at the structure first. curl -s fetches the answer without the progress bar. jq '.' prints it with indentation so you can see the field names. head keeps 30 lines.
steps.expect: Indented JSON, for example {, then "items": [ with objects that have "name" and "active" fields.

steps.explain: Keep only the wanted items. jq -r reads the data and prints strings without quotes. .items[] goes through each item, select keeps the ones where active is true, and .name prints the name field.
steps.expect: One name per line, for example alpha and gamma.

alternatives.explain: Same filter on a JSON file already saved on disk, for example after curl -s URL -o items.json.
